name: takt-wordpress-e2e
description: End-to-end harness for the Takt WordPress plugin (wp-env + Playwright + mocked ingest).

scripts.e2e: wp-env start && wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/takt-wordpress/e2e/setup-wp.php && playwright test --grep-invert @route-templates && npm run e2e:route-templates
scripts.e2e:route-templates: wp-env run cli wp eval-file wp-content/plugins/takt-wordpress/e2e/setup-route-templates.php && playwright test --grep @route-templates
